title: Agriculture Minister Yana faces censure motion over comments on budget cuts
summary: The opposition considers submitting a censure motion against Minister Yana following his remarks on cuts to local project funds, while the prime minister defends him.

title: Fraud scandal at Prudential Japan reaches 5.2 billion yen
summary: Insurer Prudential reveals internal fraud of 5.2 billion yen and admits an aggressive sales culture that fostered misconduct.

title: Data breach of 6.43 million customers at Book-Off due to unauthorized access
summary: Used book chain Book-Off suffers cyberattack exposing names, birth dates, and emails of millions of users.

title: Cabinet approves bill to cut consumption tax to 1% on food without defining funding
summary: Japanese government approves temporary cut of consumption tax to 1% for food, but leaves funding source and beneficiaries undecided.

title: Actors Mana Ashida and Masato Sakai debut as hosts of Kōhaku Uta Gassen festival
summary: NHK announces actors Mana Ashida and Masato Sakai, along with Kazunari Ninomiya, will host the 77th edition of the popular year-end music contest.

title: Leak of 14.6 million records on flight platform SkyTicket due to cyberattack
summary: Unauthorized access to SkyTicket reservation system compromises personal information of over 14 million users.

title: United States accuses Nicolás Maduro and his wife of conspiracy to torture thousands of opponents
summary: U.S. justice charges Venezuelan president and his wife with running a torture apparatus that included electric shocks to U.S. citizens.

title: U.S. plans to livestream firing squad execution of convicted former soldier
summary: Department of Defense authorizes live broadcast of death penalty for former serviceman, an unprecedented measure in the country's recent history.

title: Tokyo Metropolitan Police creates first specialized unit for autonomous driving
summary: The new department will handle regulation of driving permits and investigation of accidents involving driverless vehicles.

title: Japanese public servants receive pay raise for fifth consecutive year
summary: Government accepts National Personnel Authority recommendation and raises salaries and bonuses of state employees.

title: Honda to acquire pickups from Mitsubishi Motors for sale in Southeast Asia from 2028
summary: The two Japanese automakers expand alliance with OEM supply agreement including off-road vehicles for emerging markets.

title: Nikkei falls over 800 points dragged down by tech and semiconductor stocks
summary: Tokyo stock chain declines amid macroeconomic concerns, despite strong Fast Retailing results.

title: Kyoto cuts subsidies to international institute after accident in Henoko waters
summary: Prefecture punishes educational center for its students' participation in protest against U.S. military base that ended in boat capsizing.
